## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature. Mention any dependencies that are required for this change.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Contract update (Soroban smart contract changes, storage layouts, or entrypoints)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Quality & Testing Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or compiler errors
- [ ] `cargo test` passes locally for contracts (if contract files modified)
- [ ] `npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass locally for frontend/backend/custodian
- [ ] Unit or integration tests have been added/updated covering the changes
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive configuration values are committed
